Eve - Album 1: WHO

Destinations and Connections

"Every photograph has someone standing just beyond the edge"

[Intro]

Footsteps fade The hallway clears One old voice Through fifty years

A stranger waits But knows this place And somehow knows My grandmother’s face

[Verse 1]

He looked older than the house felt old Thin white hair and fingers cold A cane beside him, shoulders worn Like he’d been tired before I was born

But his eyes were bright Alive and clear Nothing faded Nothing disappeared

Sit, child, please No need to stand

His voice moved slowly Like an hourglass in hand

Hansel

That was all he gave Then looked around the room

I was a friend of Mary

And suddenly Grandma had another name in someone else’s memory

[Pre-Chorus]

Mary

I hadn’t heard her called that way Not with history behind the name

Not Grandma Not the woman who raised me

Someone else’s Mary From another time completely

[Chorus]

Destinations and connections Roads that crossed before my own Lives that ran beside each other Long before I had a home

Destinations and connections Names I thought I understood Every answer finds another road Every road another wood

He knew her then I know her now

Somewhere between us There’s a story somehow

[Verse 2]

He said they had been close once Closer than most would know But fifty years had gathered Since he’d watched her go

There had been disagreement He never called it more Something neither one surrendered Something left outside the door

She used to live here Long before my time Walked these halls Called this estate mine

He heard she’d passed He came too late The funeral already gone

So he came here instead To visit what remained

And found me standing where she’d once belonged

[Pre-Chorus]

I wanted to ask What happened then Why fifty years could separate friends

But something in his face Made questions wait

Some stories need permission Some answers need their date

[Chorus]

Destinations and connections Paths that split and disappear Some return after a lifetime Some arrive too late to hear

Destinations and connections People bound by things unsaid Every photograph has someone Standing just beyond the edge

He knew her young I knew her old

And both of us Were missing what she never told

[Bridge]

Then Hansel reached inside his coat And placed a key into my hand

Old metal Dark with age Heavier than something small should weigh

She gave me this a long time ago He said it had been mine to keep I tried returning it for years

But Mary always sent it back to me

Now she cannot

So you must

He closed my fingers over it

There were eleven keys

He looked toward the floor below

One of them opens that door

[Final Chorus]

Destinations and connections One old key, one hidden way Eleven pieces of a story Scattered somewhere far away

Destinations and connections Every ending leaves a thread Mary’s gone but all around me Something keeps moving ahead

I hold the key He takes his cane

The house feels different After hearing Grandma’s name

[Outro]

Hansel reaches the doorway Then turns once more

Take care now

And nothing more

He walks away Slow down the hall

One old man One ancient key

Eleven keys

One locked door

And suddenly Tomorrow feels very far from ordinary
